messages:
Mira (support): :rotating_light: Customer reporting sudden spike of 502s from hosted API (eu1). Started ~08:12 UTC, ~15% errors on short-lived streaming requests. Tenant: acme-inc. Sample req ids: rQe-9a1, rQe-9a7, rQe-9b2.
Mira (support): Basic repro curl from customer attached, they hit 502s intermittently.
Mira (support): curl sample:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Request-ID: rQe-9a1" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Sanjay (eng-sre): oncall pinged? @Jamal can you take a look at edge in eu1?
Jamal (oncall): I’m on it, grabbing traces for the sample req ids. pulling envoy logs now.
OpsBot (bot): Deployed: edge-gateway v1.14.3 at 2026-03-18T07:55:02Z to eu1.
Mira (support): Customer says it coincided with tenant token rotation window (~08:10 UTC).
Sophie (infra): Noted. Last auth-service deploy was 06:40 UTC but token rotation job runs hourly.
Jamal (oncall): Found rQe-9a1 in edge logs: upstream reset before response, envoy returned 502. snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T08:12:03Z] req=rQe-9a1 proxy_to_upstream: rst_stream code=PROTOCOL_ERROR
[2026-03-18T08:12:03Z] req=rQe-9a1 envoy: upstream prematurely closed connection -> 502
```
Jamal (oncall): I also see auth cache miss spam for that tenant around same time. auth-service returning 503 for short burst (circuit open).
Sanjay (eng-sre): That matches a pattern: if auth returns 5xx, edge treats it as upstream error and surfaces 502 to client. Need to confirm if keepalive pools exhausted or concurrent auth fanout.
Mira (support): Customer says they were sending short 1-3s streaming requests (many small tokens). Could be keepalive churn.
Sophie (infra): Checking ingress connection pools. Current metrics: h2 connection usage for auth-backend peaked at 140% of configured pool (we saw queueing).
Sophie (infra): paging config for auth upstream looks like default pool=100, concurrency burst to 300. we hit queueing and auth started failing with 503 from its side.
Jamal (oncall): Patch mitigation: increasing auth upstream pool on eu1 should reduce queueing. I'll bump pool to 400 temporarily and restart auth-proxy.
Sanjay (eng-sre): Also let's enable short-term retry/backoff at edge for auth calls (1 retry with jitter) to avoid immediate 502s, and add an upstream fallback to auth-secondary.
Mira (support): Can we provide customer workaround while we fix infra?
Jamal (oncall): Yes — route their traffic to eu2 as a stopgap for their tenant. I can update routing for acme-inc to eu2 for next 30m.
Mira (support): I’ll tell customer to retry to eu2 and monitor. Thanks. :thumbsup:
OpsBot (bot): Runbook check: if auth circuit opens, edge will return 502 for protected endpoints. See runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/auth-circuit.
Sanjay (eng-sre): Followups:
- Jamal: confirm pool bump reduced queueing and reprocess sample reqs.
- Sophie: audit auth job token rotation timing, ensure it staggers across instances.
- Support: notify customer of temporary eu2 routing and ETA.
Jamal (oncall): Pool bump done at 08:18 UTC. Watching metrics.
Jamal (oncall): After bump, auth 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 0.5% in 3m. Replayed rQe-9a1 locally and got 200.
Sophie (infra): Found token-rotation job schedule overlapping with cache eviction for that tenant (race). I'll add jitter and deploy patch to stagger by tenant hash.
Mira (support): Customer confirms lower 502 rate after we routed them to eu2 and we increased pool. They saw >95% success now.
Sanjay (eng-sre): Long term: consider auth cache warmers and rate-limited prefetch for hot tenants, and increase default keepalive pools for h2. Also add better observability mapping from 502s -> upstream auth 5xx root cause.
Mira (support): Closing loop: I’ll update ticket with repro steps, mitigations, and next steps.
Mira (support): Ticket update draft:
"Root cause: auth-service cache eviction + token rotation overlapped -> auth backend 503s -> edge returned 502s for short streaming requests. Mitigation: increased auth pool, routed tenant to eu2, staggered rotation jobs. Next steps: deploy rotation jitter and add cache warmers"
Sanjay (eng-sre): LGTM. Marking for post-incident review.
Jamal (oncall): tagging traces and saving logs: trace ids archived -> s3://redwood-debug/1829992222/
Mira (support): Thanks team. I'll send customer summary and close when they ack. :white_check_mark:
